items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: Well, he, I was living with my grandmother and he came to stay with us and he stayed there quite a while.

ctx.x: Yeah. Paul, I think I would, again, your uncle, Peter, do you remember anything about him? Is he the oldest one? He was the oldest.

Older than your father. Yes, yes. Well, he, I was living with my grandmother and he came to stay with us and he stayed there quite a while. Well, at that particular time he was mostly a barber. He didn't play too regular. And he stayed in the profession until he died.
Now, do you remember about when he died? I know it's hard to bring up those dates and all.
